failure: Failure: This is not atom-count-free or exact for finite-N deformed-Wigner data. Adaptive-node finite-N stability is not certified, ordinary floating PSD signs are not certified, and non-atomic signals can confound removable semicircular variance.
interface: Interface: Exact limiting transform samples; known k or an upper bound to choose m>=k; exactly k distinct real atoms with positive weights; additive semicircular noise. The m=k realization assumes the stated nondegenerate positive Pick matrix.

claims.title: Exact Pick feasibility identifies semicircular variance for a known atomic model
